description: t2-segment-word-delimited：空格分词语言的 T2 守卫 —— 占位符切分与按词计数的锚点强度

cases.name: 「go, I,」锚点在原文中紧邻下一锚点：占位符不争抢 → segmented
cases.excerpt: the court will go, I, 〔略〕 will enforce the judgment by execution.

expect.span: the court will go, I, will enforce the judgment by execution.
expect.visible: the court will go, I, will enforce the judgment by execution.

cases.name: 同一行的另一处相邻边界：「the court」与「will go, I,」共享唯一占位符
cases.excerpt: fails to pay, the court 〔略〕 will go, I,

expect.span: fails to pay, the court will go, I,
expect.visible: fails to pay, the court will go, I,

cases.name: 两短词锚点「I am」字符不足 4 但词数足够 → segmented（按词而非按字符）
cases.excerpt: I am 〔略〕 arbitrate any dispute arising hereunder.

expect.span: I am the prevailing party, and the parties further agree to arbitrate any dispute arising hereunder.
expect.visible: I am the prevailing party, and the parties further agree to arbitrate any dispute arising hereunder.

cases.name: 单个短词锚点「go」仍太弱 → none（一个词散布全篇）
cases.excerpt: go 〔略〕 arbitrate any dispute arising hereunder.
